title: Understanding the Scatterplot
text: Observe the scatterplot of $$z$$ versus $$y$$. Notice the pattern of the data points. Does it resemble a linear, quadratic, or another type of relationship?

title: Identifying the Pattern
text: The scatterplot shows a curve that seems to rise more steeply as $$z$$ increases. This suggests a non-linear relationship. Consider transformations that can linearize such patterns.

title: Choosing the Right Transformation
text: Which transformation could potentially linearize a relationship where $$y$$ increases rapidly as $$z$$ increases?
